data.situation: The next week, Lin received the essay she had submitted about the garden project. A grade was written at the top, with a comment asking for a clearer example. She laid the paper on the left of a classroom desk. The result disappointed her, but the comment gave her something she could act on. She asked the teacher to explain the grade. The teacher pointed to a paragraph where Lin had named a problem without showing how it affected the gardeners. Lin wrote one real situation on a card in the middle of the desk. Her presentation was scheduled for the following class. On the screen to the right, she prepared one slide showing a dry garden during a holiday. She would present the group's findings, then explain why a shared watering plan mattered. When the day came, she put the example before the long list of ideas. A classmate asked how the group would share the task fairly. Lin used the card to explain their proposed plan. She still wanted a better result next time, but now she knew which part of the work needed to become clearer.
data.zhSupport: grade 是成绩名词；present 是展示动词。presentation 是一场正式报告，实际说清发现比堆术语更重要。这里只教表达与反馈，不把虚构成绩当作雅思评分。
data.easySummary: Lin asks about her result. She finds a clearer example and uses it when she speaks to the class.
data.easySummaryZh: 林询问成绩反馈，找到更清楚的例子，并在向全班报告时使用它。

glossary.note: 围绕特定主题的短篇写作；此处是课程写作任务，不等同任何雅思官方题目。
glossary.example: My essay explains the garden project.
glossary.exampleZh: 我的短文解释花园项目。

glossary.note: 给学习作业的评分或等级；本课为名词，不引入评分动词义。
glossary.exampleZh: 能解释一下我的成绩吗？

glossary.note: 正式向听众提供信息或展示事物如何运作的讲话；不是呈现状态名词。
glossary.example: My presentation starts with a concrete example.
glossary.exampleZh: 我的报告从一个具体例子开始。

glossary.note: 向听众展示发现；来源为动词，不使用礼物名词或现在的形容词义。
glossary.example: I will present our findings to the class.
glossary.exampleZh: 我会向全班展示我们的发现。

glossary.zh: 能解释一下我的成绩吗？
glossary.note: 请求理解评分与改进处，不等于要求教师提高成绩。
glossary.example: Could you explain my grade and the comment?
glossary.exampleZh: 能解释一下我的成绩和这条批注吗？
matchTexts: Could you explain my grade and the comment?

glossary.note: 把所观察或分析到的结果展示给听众；不把示范故事当成已做真实研究。
glossary.example: We will present our findings with an example.
glossary.exampleZh: 我们会用一个例子展示我们的发现。
matchTexts: We will present our findings with an example.

glossary.note: 以可理解情境说明观点；不是泛泛说“例如”后仍不提供内容。
glossary.example: I will give a concrete example before the list.
glossary.exampleZh: 我会先给一个具体例子，再列出清单。
matchTexts: I will give a concrete example before the list.

retrievalPrompts.cue: The teacher returned your writing with a result and a short comment. Ask for an explanation of the result.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 教师退回作文，写了成绩与一条批注。请求解释这个成绩。
acceptableAnswers: Could you explain my grade and the comment, please?
retrievalPrompts.feedback: Ask for understanding and improvement rather than a higher mark without a reason.
retrievalPrompts.feedbackZh: 请求理解和改进，不无理由地要求提高分数。

retrievalPrompts.cue: A classmate asks what the short piece of writing is about. Tell them its topic.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 同学问你的短篇写作讲什么。告诉他主题。
acceptableAnswers: My essay is about the garden project.
I wrote an essay about planning the community garden.
retrievalPrompts.feedback: Name the type of work and its particular subject.
retrievalPrompts.feedbackZh: 说出写作类型及具体主题。

retrievalPrompts.cue: You will speak to the class next time. Say what you will show and how you will begin the talk.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 下次你要向全班报告。说明将展示什么，以及报告如何开始。
acceptableAnswers: In my presentation, I will present our findings and start with a concrete example.
In my presentation, I will start with an example and then present our findings to the class.
retrievalPrompts.feedback: The talk is a noun; showing the findings is an action. Keep the example useful to the audience.
retrievalPrompts.feedbackZh: 报告是名词，展示发现是动作；例子应帮助听众理解。

transferPrompt.function: Explain findings to a new audience
transferPrompt.cue: Your volunteer team checked how visitors use a park. Tell the team you will show the findings and give one example.
transferPrompt.cueZh: 换到志愿团队：你们查看了访客如何使用公园。告诉团队，你将展示发现并给一个例子。
acceptableAnswers: I will present our findings to the team and give a concrete example.
We will present our findings with a concrete example from the park.
transferPrompt.feedback: Change the audience and keep the action linked to actual findings.
transferPrompt.feedbackZh: 更换听众，并把展示动作与实际发现联系起来。
